the inclusion of a quantum potential induced by the geometry of the manifold onto which the quantum system is constrained leads to bound states in the energy spectrum of such system.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a quantum potential can be induced by a geometry and that it can have physical consequences in terms of the existence of bound states.
the geometry induced quantum potential has a significant effect on the physical properties of the constrained quantum system.
